summary: FERC dismisses Eolian's request for rehearing or clarification of the June 18 NYISO show cause order, because that order made only preliminary findings and is not a final order, and declines to clarify while the proceeding is in abeyance.

points.point: Eolian sought a ruling that proximate generation can get permanent load-limited generator interconnection service.
points.quote: electrically proximate generation may access permanent load-limited generator interconnection service where it is equally capable of enabling the large load to limit its withdrawals from the transmission system

points.point: FERC says the show cause order was not final, so rehearing is unavailable.
points.quote: The Commission determined only that the Tariff appears to be unjust, unreasonable, and unduly discriminatory or preferential and instituted an FPA section 206 show cause proceeding to reach a final determination on this issue.

points.point: FERC dismisses the clarification request and will not issue guidance during abeyance.
points.quote: We do not intend to provide clarification or guidance with respect to the Show Cause Order while the show cause proceeding is held in abeyance.

points.point: FERC encourages NYISO, the transmission owners and stakeholders to continue developing section 205 proposals.
points.quote: We encourage NYISO, the Transmission Owners, and stakeholders to continue with the development of one or more FPA section 205 proposals.

throughLine.text: Treats the E-12 NYISO order as non-final and dismisses a rehearing request aimed at its proximate-generation directive, leaving clarification until after the abeyance ends November 16, 2026.
